evals.prompt: Cut release v0.4.3 for onde-cli. Bump all version pins, follow the repo's release branch flow, tag, and push.
evals.expected_output: Agent bumps Cargo.toml, pubspec.yaml, server.json (3 spots), commits signed with Co-Authored-By trailer, creates release/v0.4.3 from development, merges --no-ff into development then main, tags the main merge commit, pushes development+main+tag, and watches the release pipeline.

evals.prompt: We fast-forwarded main to the version bump commit by mistake and tagged it. development is now behind main. Fix the repo state without rewriting pushed history.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes the git skill's rule (tag belongs on a merge commit; development must carry the release state) and back-merges main into development with --no-ff instead of rewriting main or deleting the pushed tag.

evals.prompt: The v0.4.2 tag push failed the crates.io verify step because pubspec.yaml still said 0.4.1. Nothing was published. Walk me through fixing it and re-releasing.
evals.expected_output: Agent fixes the pubspec version on a new release branch or hotfix, re-runs the release flow, deletes and recreates the tag only if crates.io never published, and explains why crates.io versions are immutable so a published 0.4.2 would require 0.4.3 instead.

evals.prompt: Update the README install instructions for the npm wrapper and fix the NuGet README badge that points at the wrong package id.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT deeply engage the release skill beyond reading it; this is distribution/README work. Agent edits npm/onde-cli/README.md and nuget/onde-cli/README.md without cutting a release, bumping versions, or tagging.

evals.prompt: Merge the feature/lora-scheduler branch into development.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger the release skill; this is a normal feature merge governed by the git skill (--no-ff into development, no tag).
